name: AI Graduate Application Tracker - Public Template

attributes.name: job_related
attributes.description: Whether this email relates to a job application, recruitment process, interview, assessment, rejection or offer

attributes.name: company
attributes.description: Name of the company or organisation associated with the application. Do not guess if unknown

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Job title or graduate role mentioned in the email. Do not guess if unknown

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Classify as APPLICATION_CONFIRMATION, ASSESSMENT_INVITATION, VIDEO_INTERVIEW_INVITATION, INTERVIEW_INVITATION, ASSESSMENT_CENTRE_INVITATION, OFFER, REJECTION, GENERAL_APPLICATION_UPDATE, or NOT_JOB_RELATED

attributes.name: detected_status
attributes.description: Current application status: Applied, Application Received, Online Assessment, Video Interview, Interview, Assessment Centre, Final Interview, Offer, Rejected, or Withdrawn

attributes.name: ai_confidence
attributes.description: Confidence from 0 to 1 in the classification

attributes.name: candidate_applied
attributes.description: Determine whether this email relates to a job application that the candidate has actually submitted.  Set candidate_applied = true when the email provides evidence that the candidate has already applied for the specific role.  Examples include: - application confirmations - assessment invitations - video interview invitations - interview invitations - assessment centre invitations - application status updates - offers - rejection emails relating to an application  The role can be ANY employment role, including graduate, junior, entry-level, internship, placement, trainee, analyst, associate, apprenticeship, or other jobs.  Set candidate_applied = false for: - job advertisements - job alerts - recruiter outreach where the candidate has not applied - LinkedIn job recommendations - speculative opportunities - newsletters - general careers marketing  Do not assume the candidate applied simply because the email discusses a job.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You analyse emails for a graduate job application tracking system.

Extract information only from the email provided.

Do not invent company names, job titles, statuses or other information that is not supported by the email.

An email is job-related if it concerns a job application, recruitment process, assessment, interview, assessment centre, application update, rejection, withdrawal or job offer.

Use only the permitted classification and status values defined in the schema.

If the email is not related to a job application, set job_related to false and classification to NOT_JOB_RELATED.

Return the most appropriate current application status based on what the email says.
